children: Diversified Energy Co. (DEC) filed a Form 8K - Regulation FD Disclosure - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 03, 2026.

On September 2, 2026, Diversified Energy Company (the "Company") issued a press release announcing the entry into definitive acquisition agreements to acquire Birch Permian Holdings, Inc. and certain affiliated companies . A copy of the Company's press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 hereto and is incorporated into this Item 7.01 by reference. On September 2, 2026, the Company posted on its website, www.div.energy, an investor presentation, a copy of which can be reviewed at the Company's website by first selecting "Investor Resources," then selecting the "Presentations" tab.

The information in this Item 7.01 and Exhibit 99.1 attached hereto is being furnished and shall not be deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that section, nor shall it be deemed incorporated by reference into any filing made by the Company under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, regardless of any general incorporation language in such filings, except as shall be expressly set forth by specific reference in such a filing.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1922446/000192244626000083/dec-20260902.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1922446/000192244626000083/0001922446-26-000083-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
